propositions.name: aether_is_absolute_rest_frame
propositions.statement: The quiescent underlying aether is the spacial framework in absolute rest introduced by Newton for dynamics.
propositions.quote: the spacial framework in absolute rest, which was introduced by Newton and was probably a main source of the great advance in abstract dynamics originated by the Principia , is in fact the quiescent underlying æther

propositions.name: space_of_reference_fixed_to_aether
propositions.statement: The space of reference for the electric equations is fixed with respect to the stagnant aether, so matter has a definite velocity (p, q, r) relative to it.
propositions.quote: let the space of reference be fixed with respect to the stagnant æther, and ( p, q, r ) be the velocity with which the matter situated at the point ( x, y, z ) is moving

propositions.name: euclidean_relations_of_space
propositions.statement: The measurements in space obey Euclidean relations which are part of the ultimate scheme of physical representation.
propositions.quote: The sole spacial relations of the æther itself, on which its dynamics depend, those namely of incompressibility and rotational elasticity, are thus to be classed along with the existing Euclidean relations of measurements in space

propositions.name: spacial_framework_required_for_dynamics
propositions.statement: A definite spacial framework, fixed or moving, to which motion is referred is a necessary part of any dynamical theory.
propositions.quote: The objection that rotational elasticity postulates absolute directions in space need hardly have weight when it is considered that a definite space, or spacial framework fixed or moving, to which motion is referred

propositions.name: matter_moves_across_aether_with_definite_velocity
propositions.statement: A material body has a definite uniform velocity v moving across the aether.
propositions.quote: let us consider the free æther for which K and μ are unity, containing a definite system of electrons which are grouped into the molecules of a material body moving across the æther with uniform velocity v parallel to the axis of x

propositions.name: atoms_composed_of_electrons
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion in the aether.
propositions.quote: atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion

propositions.name: molecular_constitution_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, so the correspondence argument between moving and rest systems carries through.
propositions.quote: conversely it will involve evidence that the constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented

propositions.name: body_shrunk_in_direction_of_motion
propositions.statement: A body in uniform motion is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the derived ratio.
propositions.quote: one consequence of the motion thus being that the body is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio

propositions.name: time_variable_change_is_mathematical
propositions.statement: The primed time t', equal to t minus vx over c-squared, is a mathematical change of variable used to reduce the moving-system equations to a rest-system form.
propositions.quote: Now change the time variable from t to t', equal to

propositions.name: reduced_form_is_medium_at_rest
propositions.statement: After the change of time variable, the equations assume the form of an electric scheme for a crystalline medium at rest, so the primed system is treated as a rest system in true time.
propositions.quote: and these equations assume the form of an electric scheme for a crystalline medium at rest

propositions.name: difference_of_time_reckoning_across_positions
propositions.statement: Because of the change of time variable, electrons at different positions in the direction of v are slightly further on in their orbits on account of the difference of time-reckoning.
propositions.quote: while those less advanced in the direction of v are also relatively very slightly further on in their orbits on account of the difference of time-reckoning

propositions.name: corresponding_states_at_each_instant
propositions.statement: If two aethereal systems are set free at any instant in corresponding states, they will be in corresponding states at each subsequent instant, so there is a single sequence of instants shared across both systems.
propositions.quote: if these two æthereal systems are set free at any instant in corresponding states, they will be in corresponding states at each subsequent instant

propositions.name: instantaneous_transmission_through_incompressible_medium
propositions.statement: A disturbance can be instantaneously communicated throughout the incompressible aether to the vacuous nuclei of the electrons.
propositions.quote: instantaneously communicated throughout the incompressible medium to the only places that can respond to it, the vacuous nuclei of the electrons

propositions.name: magnetic_force_instantaneously_transmitted_gravitation
propositions.statement: The electron is a centre of alternating intrinsic magnetic force instantaneously transmitted, because a finite transmission time would involve condensation of the incompressible medium.
propositions.quote: postulating that the electron is not only a centre of steady intrinsic electric force, but also a centre of alternating intrinsic magnetic force, instantaneously transmitted because it would otherwise involve condensation

propositions.name: ascertained_velocity_of_radiation
propositions.statement: There is a definite ascertained velocity of radiation to which the elasticity and inertia of the aether are calibrated.
propositions.quote: we have been compelled to assume a high coefficient of inertia of the medium, and therefore an extremely high elasticity in order to conserve the ascertained velocity of radiation

propositions.name: steady_motion_requires_configuration_fixed_to_aether
propositions.statement: For a steady state without conduction currents the matter's configuration must be permanent and its motion the same at all times relative to that configuration and to the aether.
propositions.quote: it is necessary that the configuration of the matter shall be permanent, and that its motion shall be the same at all times relative to this configuration and to the æther

propositions.name: circuital_relations_determine_subsequent_stages
propositions.statement: The circuital relations form a first-order differential scheme which determines the subsequent stages of a system step by step from its initial state.
propositions.quote: Inasmuch as the circuital relations form a differential scheme of the first order which determines step by step the subsequent stages of a system when its initial state is given

propositions.name: aether_and_matter_have_distinct_dynamics
propositions.statement: The aether, not being matter, need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter but must obey another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves.
propositions.quote: The æther not being matter, it need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obey another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves

propositions.name: free_charge_carried_with_matter
propositions.statement: In a steady state the electrons that constitute electric densities are wholly carried on by the matter.
propositions.quote: will lead to the electrons constituting electric densities being wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained

propositions.name: aether_continuous_homogeneous_incompressible
propositions.statement: The aether is a continuous, homogeneous, incompressible medium endowed with inertia and rotational elasticity.
propositions.quote: the æther to be a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium, endowed with inertia and with elasticity purely rotational

propositions.name: aether_isotropic_and_irrotational_apart_from_electric_force
propositions.statement: The rotational aether is irrotational except where electric force exists, which produces rotation proportional to its intensity.
propositions.quote: the motion of our rotational æther in the previous papers is irrotational except where electric force exists which produces rotation proportional to its intensity

propositions.name: electrons_are_persistent_singularities
propositions.statement: Permanent conjugate electrons persist in the medium and can be moved about through it until destroyed by a reverse process.
propositions.quote: We shall thus have created two permanent conjugate electrons A and B; each of them can be moved about through the medium, but they will both persist until they are destroyed by an extraneous process

propositions.name: gravitation_requires_aethereal_transmission
propositions.statement: A theory that explains atoms as singularities of strain and motion in the aether is bound to look for an explanation of gravitation by means of the properties of that medium.
propositions.quote: explains atoms of matter as made up of singularities of strain and motion in the æther, is bound to look for an explanation of gravitation by means of the properties of that medium

propositions.name: field_around_moving_system_maps_to_rest_system
propositions.statement: The distribution of electric force around a system moving through the aether is precisely the same as if the system were at rest, with the surrounding space's isotropic constant replaced by an aeolotropic one.
propositions.quote: The distribution of electric force is therefore precisely the same as if the system were at rest, and the isotropic dielectric constant unity of the surrounding space changed into an aeolotropic one

propositions.name: force_derived_from_energy_function
propositions.statement: The scientific method of describing transmission of force by a medium is to assign the mathematical energy function and derive stresses from it by the principle of virtual work.
propositions.quote: the scientific method of describing them is to assign the mathematical function which represents its energy of strain, and thence derive its relations of stress by the principle of virtual work

propositions.name: faradays_law_holds_for_circuit_moving_with_matter
propositions.statement: The line integral of electric force round a circuit in uniform motion with the matter equals the time-rate of diminution of the magnetic flux through its aperture.
propositions.quote: Faraday's law follows that the line integral of electric force round a circuit in uniform motion with the matter is equal to the time-rate of diminution of the magnetic flux through its aperture

propositions.name: actual_form_of_bodies_changes_with_motion
propositions.statement: Conductors put in motion through the aether change their actual forms to a slight extent depending on (v/c) squared.
propositions.quote: change their actual forms to a slight extent depending on (v/c)² when they are put in motion

propositions.name: single_time_defined_at_every_point
propositions.statement: There is a single time t used in d/dt at every point of the aether, in which the fundamental circuital equations hold.
propositions.quote: the alteration thus produced in the fundamental æthereal equations

propositions.name: positions_matter_relative_to_extraneous_spacial_framework
propositions.statement: The kinetic part of the energy is specified in terms of the rate of change of configuration of a material system relative to an extraneous spacial framework.
propositions.quote: The other main division of the energy is the kinetic part, which is specified in terms of the rate of change of configuration of the material system with respect to an extraneous spacial framework to which its position is referred

propositions.name: convective_derivative_uses_vector_addition_of_velocity
propositions.statement: The operator delta over dt combines the partial time derivative with the components p, q, r of the matter's velocity through space by simple addition.
propositions.quote: let ρ denote density of free electric charge
